title: Legal Redlines Scratchpad - Contract Negotiation Notes
content:
Working notes for upcoming negotiation with Acme Corp (SOW + Master Service Agreement). Informal scratchpad - pull into formal redline later.

Priority clauses to watch:
- Indemnity: customer requests broad vendor indemnity for 3rd party claims. Push for mutual indemnity and carve-outs for Redwood's negligence and open-source contributions.
- Liability cap: counter to 'unlimited' or revenue-based; propose cap = greater of $1M or 12 months of fees, with carve-outs for IP infringement and willful misconduct.
- Exclusion of consequential damages: ensure language covers punitive and indirect damages; keep carve-outs narrow.
- Security / Data Processing: require DPA (references GDPR / CCPA), limit processing to instructions, subprocessor list + notice model. Note: Acme asked for cross-border transfer assurances - propose SCCs + standard contractual clauses + KMS options.
- Data ownership & IP: vendor retains model & platform IP; customer owns customer data and outputs. Watch for "work product" definitions that might assign rights incorrectly.
- Audit rights: limit frequency (once per 12 months), scope, and require reasonable notice and mutually agreed audit firm. Ensure indemnity for audit-related data access.
- Subprocessors & subcontracting: require notice + right to object for high-risk subprocessors; standard '90 days' notice is ok.
- Service levels & credits: agree to SLOs we can meet; avoid tight latency SLOs for edge cases. Credits capped at a percentage of monthly fees.
- Termination & transition: include migration assistance for 90 days post-termination and data deletion certification.
- Confidentiality & residuals: limit residuals to unavoidable memory; add Narrow residuals clause.
- Insurance: require standard commercial general liability + cyber/tech E&O; specific limits to be negotiated (CYBER $1M+).
- Governing law & venue: prefer CA (home) or neutral state; push back on customer's local-only venue requests.
- Export controls & sanctions: standard compliance representations; reserve right to suspend service for sanctioned entities.

Negotiation talking points / fallback positions:
- Indemnity: "We can accept mutual IP infringement indemnity; for other claims, mutual indemnity with negligence carve-outs." If they insist on unilateral vendor indemnity, require insurance and monetary cap.
- Liability cap: "Standard for Redwood is fees cap or fixed $1M - we can escalate to $3M for strategic enterprise deals with exec approval."
- Data processing: "We will sign a standard DPA. For KMS/customer-keyed encryption, needs dedicated infra or Dedicated offering (ops/config lead time)."
- Audit: "Limit to one audit per 12 months, remote-first, scoped to security controls that relate to the Customer only."
- Migration assistance: "We will provide export of customer data in commonly-used formats and 90 days of transition support; extended assistance is billable."

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm if Acme requires customer-controlled KMS (if yes, route to Private deployment team).
- Check SOW for sample traffic volumes - expose to infra team to confirm SLO feasibility.
- Ask Sales for commercial levers: historical discount thresholds, target ACV, any mandated SLAs.
- Loop in Privacy (Maya) for international data transfer language and SCC strategy.
- Determine if we should offer a limited pilot with reduced liability caps (implementation-specific).

Quick references:
- Contracts playbook: Confluence > Legal > Third-Party & Customer Contracts (CONFLUENCE-Contracts-Playbook)
- Standard DPA template: internal-dpa-v3 (use if customer wants GDPR details)
- Previous negotiation: legal-redlines-scratchpad-olivia-wright.json (similar clauses; copy recommended language)

Suggested redline snippets to insert:
- Liability Cap: "Except for liability arising from (i) willful misconduct or gross negligence, or (ii) infringement of a party's intellectual property rights, each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable to Vendor under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim, or (b) $1,000,000."
- Indemnity (mutual): "Each party shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other party from claims arising from the indemnifying party's breach of its obligations, negligence or willful misconduct; IP claims shall be handled pursuant to Section X."
- Data deletion: "Within thirty (30) days of termination, Vendor shall, at Customer's election, return or securely delete Customer Data and provide written certification of deletion within forty-five (45) days."

Notes to self: keep language simple, avoid 'sublicense' traps, and prefer mutual obligations over one-sided obligations whenever feasible. Save final redline as 'MSA-Acme-Redline-v1.docx' and request Legal review before sending to counterparty.

Status: draft - will convert into formal redline and attach to JIRA-LEG-128 when ready.
